resolved.title: 索引和切片
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Indexing and Slicing[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

NumPy arrays can be indexed and sliced the same way that Python lists are.

[b]For example: [/b][code format="py" codeId="3219"]x = np.arange(1, 10)

print(x[0:2])
print(x[5:])
print(x[:2])
print(x[-3:]) [/code]
[note]Negative indexes count from the end of the array, so, [-3:] will result in the last 3 elements.[/note]

**比如：**

**For example: **

content.content:
import numpy as np

x = np.arange(1, 10)

print(x[0:2]) # [1 2]
print(x[5:])  # [6 7 8 9]
print(x[:2])  # [1 2]
print(x[-3:]) # [7 8 9]

content.text: 负数的索引从数组的末端开始计算，所以，`[-3:]`为最后3个元素。

resolved.title: 条件选择
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Conditions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can provide a condition as the index to select the elements that fulfill the given condition.

For example, let's select the elements that are less than 4:[code format="py" codeId="3220"]x = np.arange(1, 10)

print(x[x<4]) [/code]
Conditions can be combined using the & (and) and  | (or) operators. 
For example, let's take the even numbers that are greater than 5:
[code format="py" codeId="3221"]print(x[(x>5) & (x%2==0)]) [/code]
[note]The condition can also be assigned to a variable, which will be an array of boolean values showing whether or not the values in the array fulfill the condition:
[b]y = (x>5) & (x%2==0)[/b][/note]

content.text:
你可以提供一个**条件作为索引**来选择满足给定条件的元素。

例如，让我们选择小于4的元素：
content.text_html:
You can provide a condition as the index to select the elements that fulfill the given condition.

For example, let's select the elements that are less than 4:

你可以提供一个条件作为索引来选择满足给定条件的元素。

例如，让我们选择小于4的元素。

content.content:
import numpy as np

x = np.arange(1, 10)

print(x[x<4]) # [1 2 3]

content.text:
条件可以用与`&`、或`|`运算符来组合。
例如，选择大于5且为偶数：
content.text_html:
Conditions can be combined using the & (and) and | (or) operators. For example, let's take the even numbers that are greater than 5:

条件可以用&（和）和|（或）运算符来组合。 例如，我们以大于5的偶数为例。

content.content:
import numpy as np

x = np.arange(1, 10)

print(x[(x>5) & (x%2==0)])

content.text:

`y = (x>5) & (x%2==0)`

content.title: 3和5的倍数

resolved.title: 3和5的倍数
resolved.problem_statement_md:
编写程序是找出所有小于100且同时是**3**和**5**倍数的整数。
创建一个100以下同时是3和5的倍数的数组，并输出。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Multiples of 3 & 5[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a task to find all of the whole numbers below 100 that are multiples of both [b]3[/b] and [b]5[/b].
Create an array of numbers below 100 that are multiples of both 3 and 5, and output it.
[note]You can use the [b]modulo operator %[/b] to check if a number is a multiple of another number.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 通过`np.arange(1, 100)` 创建`[1,100)` 的数组。
- 使用模运算符`%`来检查一个数字是否是另一个数字的倍数。

code_templates.solution_code:
import numpy as np

x = np.arange(1, 100)

print(x[(x%3==0) & (x%5==0)])
